changes: Family Tree: hold a name and slide it to put partners, children and brothers and sisters in order. Partners newest at the top, children oldest first.
In the tree the oldest partner sits next to them, and each child hangs from the partner they are a child of.
Wishlist: Done and Not doing ideas show one line each until tapped, and a search box, with Tile/Area, Newest or Oldest order.
Family Tree: share your tree. Who can see your tree (Menu) lets you tick who else can look at it, photos and PDFs too. Only you can change it.
When someone shares their tree with you, Yours and theirs buttons at the top switch between the trees. Theirs is to look at, not change.
Games are now played as matches: Best of 3, 5 or 7, chosen at New game, or Continue with unfinished game. The end of a match says who won it.
Under Games, a match not finished has a gold dot and a Next game button to carry it on.
Loxx: the white dice now come first. If both your marks on your own roll are in one row, the second must be the white and a colour.
In the Family Tree, women now go by the surname they were born with, as on Ancestry: their Maiden name, or Ancestry's. Contacts keeps the name they use now.
Running Bring in from Ancestry again no longer saves everyone over when nothing has changed, and People finds someone from any of the words you type.
Bring in from Ancestry now saves the links between people as well. If your tree came in without them, run it again: the links go in and nobody is doubled up.
The Family Tree now opens the zip Ancestry exports, and Bring them in works the first time, when the tree is still empty.
Dates with German months (Okt, Dez, Mai) and registration quarters (Jun Qtr 1857) are now read, and every couple from Ancestry comes in as married.
New: Family Tree. Add your ancestors and family with names, dates, places, addresses, photos and PDFs, and see them as a tree you can zoom into.
Bring your tree in from Ancestry with the file it exports, and again later with a newer one: changes come in and nobody is doubled up.
People only in the tree stay out of Contacts and birthdays. A contact can be in the tree too, and stays in it when they die.
A regular job now has a Done button on its own screen, so it can be ticked off there, not only on the list.
Each podcast's page in MY Podcasts now shows its picture at the top.
In Pounds, when someone fills a box, their card stays on your screen with that box lit up until the next player rolls.
Finished games are now split into Loxx and Pounds and grouped into matches, best of 3 or first to 5. Tap a match to see its games.
In MY Podcasts, a Spotify episode now opens Spotify searching for it, so it's usually at the top, with no scrolling through the list.
MY Podcasts can now show the episodes of podcasts on Acast, such as Half-Arsed History, which wouldn't let the app read their list before.
MY Music now opens sorted into Playlists, Albums, Songs, Artists and Stations, with genres such as Rock, Motown and Blues, and no Level to choose.
MY Podcasts opens sorted into Ongoing, Interesting and Finished, with genres such as True crime, History and Comedy.
Tap a podcast to see its episodes: tick the ones you've heard, see what's next up, show only those not listened to, or find one by its number.
Rename, remove or add genres in Settings > URL Links. Your Types, genres and ticks are yours alone.
MY Music and MY Podcasts: two new tiles that keep your favourite playlists, albums, stations and podcasts as big pictures. Tap one to play it.
To add one, press Share in Spotify or BBC Sounds and choose MY life, then Music or A podcast. Each one is kept in URL Links too.
URL Links: Open with now knows Spotify, BBC Sounds, BBC iPlayer, YouTube Music and Amazon Music, so their links open in their own app.
Finances: Find transfers has a Not these two button, so two that don’t go together are never offered again, with a way to put them back.
Diary: ticking or removing a regular job keeps its done list open and the screen where it was, instead of jumping.
Photos: each phone and computer keeps its photo links for a week, so it shows the copies it already has instead of downloading them again.
Photos: pictures no longer break when the app is open for over an hour, and one that won’t load gets one more try by itself.
Slideshow: share one with everyone or with the people you choose, and tick who can change it. The photos never go online.
Slideshow: your slideshows are on every phone and computer you sign in on, and Find the photos picks out each one's copies.
Slideshow: each one opens with Made with It’s MY life at the top, above the photo.
Send to someone: send a book, film, series, recipe or diary entry to anyone by WhatsApp, a text or email, or another app.
Contacts: Send their details to someone, as words or as a contact card they can save in their own phone.
Pick who from Contacts, or type a mobile number or email address, with a tick to add them to Contacts.
Sent to you: under Contacts you sent, the OK button no longer covers the words beside it.
Diary, Days: the Today button is gone. Days starts from today each time you open the Diary.
Slideshow: the title at the start stays about 10 seconds, long enough for Chrome's message to go before the first photo.
Slideshow: the buttons are back. They show over the title and go when the photos start; tap the middle to bring them back.
Slideshow: the first page is centred, with the seconds as numbers in circles and Upright, Sideways and Both on one line.
Slideshow: How it plays is now at the top for every slideshow, with Upright, Sideways or Both ways. Tap a slideshow to start it.
Slideshow: each show opens with its title for a few seconds, then just the photos, with no buttons on top.
The phone's Back arrow: pressing it twice or more in a row no longer closes the app.
Slideshow: choose how long each photo shows on the slideshow's own page, before you press Play.
Birthday messages: for someone in New Zealand or Australia, the Send button comes up at 8pm the night before, so it reaches them in their morning.
Slideshow: Play both ways, upright and sideways photos together, and a choice of Random or Date taken order, oldest first.
Contacts sent to you: a red number on the Contacts tile, a box asking whether to look at them now, and a list on Today.
Multi Select (was Tidy up): a tick-box button at the top of Contacts to send or delete several at once.
The phone's Back arrow now goes back one screen instead of closing the app, and stays put on the home screen.
Loxx: the words at the top now sit on the line of players, so a long message no longer squeezes the board.
Slideshow: a new tile playing your photos at random, full screen, all upright or all sideways, in slideshows of your own such as Canals or People.
Slideshow: the photos are kept on that phone or computer only, not online. Your Bluesky photo posts are a ready-made one.
Slideshow: for music or a podcast, start it in your own app first; it carries on behind the slideshow.
Birthdays: on the day, Today and their contact page have a Send Happy Birthday button. It opens WhatsApp, Messages or email ready for you to send.
Contacts: a Birthday message card on each contact with a birthday, to untick them or choose WhatsApp, text or email and which wording.
Settings: Birthday messages under Contacts, to change the wordings, add your own and star the standard one. {name} becomes their first name.
Diary: a Completed button on each appointment and a Done button on each to-do, beside +1 hr, +8 hr and +1 day.
Diary: a completed appointment now stays on the Week and Month calendars, ticked; a done to-do still comes off them. Birthdays always stay.
Timeline: a new tile drawing your life as coloured lines, today at the top and the day you were born at the bottom, a mark every five years.
Timeline: where you lived is one line coloured by country, holidays a broken line beside it, and Work, Pets and the rest a column each.
Timeline: tap a line for its dates and how long it lasted; tap a name in the key to hide it. It needs step 65 run in Supabase first.
Finances: sort codes, account numbers, IBANs and SWIFT codes larger and bold, with the examples small and pale so they don't look filled in.
TV/Movies: sharing from ITVX, Channel 4 and the like now finds the programme by the name in its link, and tries film and series.
Books and TV/Movies: an Entered by box, and Share > MY life from Amazon, IMDb, Netflix and the like now adds a book or a film.
Daily Log: the calendar stays still as you go through the months.
Loxx: Save your turn? after your last number, a gold line when you are being waited for, and Undo for a Done tapped by mistake.
TV/Movies: a new tile for films and TV series, found by name, with your stars, each time you watched, how far into a series, and your DVDs.
Recipes: in What can I make?, the first thing you type leads among recipes using one of your things, with Show more after five of them.
Recipes: What can I make? puts recipes using most of what you have first, picks out in gold those using all of it, and shows your things in bold.
Recipes: What can I make? Type what you have in, and see your recipes and ideas from TheMealDB that use it, with what else each needs.
Finances: each bank account has a SWIFT code under the IBAN, and the account number now sits beside the sort code.
Contacts: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are saved as United Kingdom, with a Part of the UK box.
Contacts: UK, GB and Great Britain become United Kingdom as you type, and NZ, Aus and USA their full names.
Loxx: untick Real dice when you start, and the phone rolls the dice. Everyone sees the same six, and what they allow is ringed.
Loxx: Play again asks first, with the same players and dice ticked, so you can change them.
All of these need step 62 run in Supabase first.
Contacts: in Grouped, UK and United Kingdom are one country, under United Kingdom. The same for NZ, Aus and USA.
Reports: Tick all and Untick all are at the top of the list of accounts, and Refresh transactions sits above the list.
Pounds: Real dice is at the top when you start a game, where you see it without scrolling past everyone.
Pounds: Play again shows the same players and dice ticked, so you can change the dice before Next.
Pounds and Loxx: when someone taps Play again, everyone else still looking at the scores goes straight to the new game.
Books: a new tile for your books, with Read, Reading and Want to read lists, your stars, notes, format, price and series.
Books: scan the barcode on the phone, or type the ISBN, and Open Library fills in the title, the author and the cover.
Books: keep who you bought it from, borrowed it from or lent it to, and links to reviews online with a line from each.
Books: share one and the people you tick can add their own stars and a few words. Only you can change the book.
Calendar: a new Days view, like a wall calendar: a line a day, weekends in red, bank holidays, birthdays and the moon’s quarters.
Days: today is shaded. Tap a day to see everything on it, and tap it again to fold it.
Wishlist: each photo on an idea has its own Copy button, so you can paste the idea and then its pictures into Claude.
Contacts: Import reads Google Contacts and Outlook files as they come, and a contact shared from Contacts or WhatsApp.
Contacts: for people already here, Import can fill in a missing phone number, email or birthday, and changes nothing already filled in.
Games: Pounds, a new five-dice game for 1 to 6 players, on your own or a phone each. Up to three rolls a turn and 13 boxes to fill; Help has the rules.
Pounds: the phone rolls the dice, or tick Real dice when you start and type in what the real ones show. Everyone sees the dice as they are rolled.
Games: each game in the list now says which game it is, Loxx or Pounds.
Settings: the accounts under Finances show just their names. Tap one to open it out; its ▾ folds it away again.
Contacts: when two people share a line at the top of a contact, as in Son of John and Mary Smith, each name opens its own page.
Today: Tonight’s idea now picks at random from all your Mains, leaving out any cooked in the last fortnight.
Loxx: only one player gets a lock and its bonus: the roller first, then the next player round who closes it. Anyone else's 12 (or 2) is a plain mark.
Loxx: Done stays greyed until everyone has tapped it. Carry on without them is now beside Stop game, so a second tap can't hit it.
Loxx: one person starts a game and the others play it from Games, Going on. New game asks first if you already have one going with the same people.
Finances: the note about rows left out of a Monzo file reads across the screen. Its button had squeezed it to one letter a line.
Finances: Monzo files exported from a search now come in. The app knows their Created column is the date and Title is what it was.
Finances: moves between a Monzo account and its pots, which that file lists twice, are left out, since together they make no difference.
Wishlist: Copy notes has gone (Copy idea copies both boxes), and Share idea sends the words and photos together, to Claude or anywhere.
Wishlist: share a screenshot to MY life from the phone's Share list and it lands on a new idea, ready to fill in.
Finances: American Express statements come in the right way round, and no longer leave rows out by mistake.
Finances: what you choose when bringing in a file is remembered for that account, and Take an import out again undoes a whole file.
Finances: when nothing comes in from a file, it now says why. And the bottom row of tiles scrolls clear of the Wishlist/Help strip.
Finances: each account in Settings in its own box, its name in bold, with its sort code, account number and IBAN.
Putting accounts in order works again: the screen moves along near the bottom, and the boxes fold to their names while one moves.
Jigsaws: a landscape puzzle opens on its page first again, with Play full screen, on its side as a button.
Loxx: the questions and messages during a game now show the same way round as the game.
Wishlist: the boxes are now Tile/Area and Description of idea/change, and Copy idea copies both.
Jigsaws: a landscape puzzle now opens filling the phone on its side. The i shows its words, the x goes back to all the puzzles.
Choosing people: the box fills the screen and only the people scroll, with a search box for name, email or phone.
Loxx: an Undo last move button, which can also open a lock you closed by mistake, until you tap Done.
Loxx: the 12 (or 2) can be taken with fewer than five marks. It scores, but only closes the lock with five marks already.
Lock Keeper is now called Loxx.
Loxx: on your own roll, each of your two numbers you don't take is a penalty, so taking neither is minus 10.
New MY Games tile, with Lock Keeper: a dice game for 2 to 5, with real dice and a phone each.
Lock Keeper: tap to mark, passed numbers are crossed out, closing a lock shuts it for everyone, and the scores add themselves up.
A long list of people (Send to, Share with) now scrolls right up to the top.
The app now tells you when a new version is ready, with what changed and a Restart now button.
Menu > What's new lists every change, newest first.
Settings > The app > People who can sign in: each person's name and phone, filled in from Contacts with one tap.
Choosing people to share with now shows their name, email and phone.
Help has a search box, and each part of it sits in its own box.
Week's menu: an x on a planned meal takes it off the menu.
A star picks whose week's menu Today shows, also in Settings > Home screen.
Settings > Home screen: the Bluesky name box is back with its Bluesky words.
Something tapped on Today opens over it, so Back comes back to Today.
Today's Menu shows each meal like the Recipes list: photo, name, categories and times.
Week's menu: each meal shows like the Recipes list, without the tall gaps.
Diary: entries about someone other than you have a pale blue background.
Hold and slide replaces the up and down arrows everywhere.
My Stuff: a star picks which photo is the big one.
Today: the weather for wherever the phone is, with a link to the Met Office.
Recipes > Week's menu: plan breakfast, lunch and dinner, and share the menu.
Diary: + asks Appointment or To-do first.
Diary: a status on appointments (Completed, Missed, Delayed, On hold, Cancelled).
Diary: birthday cakes on the month view, and tap the month's name to jump through the year.
My Stuff: a clearer message when a Boat or Loyalty card cannot be saved yet.
My Stuff: the round red +, photo counts, and coming dates under each name.
My Stuff: lock private things like a passport or will with a password of your own.
My Stuff: new Boat and Loyalty card types, and Change the type.
Typing a date: a dd/mm/yyyy box, and tap the month's name to pick the year.
Contacts: one that is used elsewhere cannot be deleted, and Menu > Find double-ups blends two into one.
Wishlist: ideas in A to Z order, and Add it stays above the keyboard.
Web addresses and emails are no longer changed by the keyboard's autocorrect.
Recipes: the cooking timer now sounds on an iPhone.
New contact: a warning about a duplicate as soon as you type the name.
Contact searches put the name first, and a new contact with a name already there asks what to do.
My Stuff: Bought from, Insurer and services chosen from Contacts, and the first photo on each row.
My Stuff: a new tile for the things you own, with photos, PDFs, a service record and due dates.
Today: a party popper on someone's birthday.
Regular jobs: hold and slide to reorder.
Sent to you: look at a contact before accepting it.
Maps: an Our location button, and an x to empty the Find box.
